user.title: Connect to UniFi
user.description: Use a local account with Network management permission. Credentials stay in Home Assistant. TLS verification should stay enabled unless your trusted console uses a self-signed certificate.

target.title: Choose the PC
target.description:
The PC must be awake and expose Windows discovery to Home Assistant. This step only reads network data.

{diagnostic}

confirm.title: Confirm discovery identity
confirm.description: No blocking is enabled during setup. This UUID is unauthenticated and may change or disappear. Verify recognition after a MAC change before relying on automation. Block PC ON requests blocking; Enforcement reports controller confirmation. Turn it OFF and verify release before removing this integration.

error.invalid_auth: Login rejected. Use a local UniFi account with Network management access.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check host, port, certificate verification and network access.
error.no_permission: No manageable site found. Grant this local account Network management access.
error.no_clients: No active, unblocked Wi-Fi clients found. Wake the PC and retry.
error.discovery_failed: No discovery UUID received. Check the PC is awake and UDP 3702 is reachable from Home Assistant.
error.invalid_host: Enter a hostname or IPv4 address without https://, a port, or a path.
error.rate_limited: UniFi temporarily rate-limited logins. Wait a few minutes before retrying; avoid repeated submissions.
error.invalid_client_address: UniFi did not report a usable IPv4 address for this PC. Check that it is connected and has an IPv4 address.
error.target_connection_failed: The enrollment check failed. See the operation and error type above; this does not necessarily mean the console address is wrong.

abort.client_changed: The client mapping changed. Start setup again.
